cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Truth or Loyalty
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between protecting the relationship and answering a dangerous question honestly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You pressed a button, so I pressed red. Client on hold. Are you going to say I copied the pitch, or protect our partnership?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Red ends the call. I pressed mute. We could withdraw the pitch and call her back together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A clean break, then. I'll withdraw it if you keep my name out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked whether you copied it. Withdrawing isn't an answer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If you tell her, don't call this a partnership. Decide before you call back.

reason: Shorten tangled before-after threat into one direct relationship condition while retaining the callback caused by the copied button mistake.
